lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Lucky Seven. Past midnight. The pie is the same. You are not as poor as last week.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: Tell me one hand you folded this week that you wanted to play.

lines.name: YOU
lines.text: Ace-queen, under the gun, deep stacks. Somebody three-bet me and I folded. It was probably good.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: Probably? Okay. Hold on to the word. In a week you'll be sitting there with a stack you can feel, and "probably" will cost you the thing you built.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: The roll isn't your score. It's your air. Every time you play above it, you're holding your breath. Nobody wins holding their breath.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: And you quit the one thing that paid on time. That's allowed. It just means you're not allowed to be sloppy. Write that down too.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Goal: build your bankroll to $5,000 before the Classic. {days} days.
